metaTitle: Highball — Your Windows Games. Now on your Mac.
metaDescription: Play Windows games on your Apple Silicon Mac with Highball. Free and open source. Bring your Steam and Epic libraries, and check your game's compatibility.
heroText: The Windows games you love. The Mac you already have. Bring them together with Highball — free, open, and ready to play.
free: Free to play. Open by nature.
scroll: A whole new side of your Mac
appAlt: The Highball app displaying a library of Windows games
gamesText: From one-more-turn nights to one-more-quest weekends. Find out how your next game runs on Mac before you download it.
searchHint: Try Portal 2, Cyberpunk 2077, or your next obsession.
featuresText: Keep the games you own. Discover what your Mac can do.
storesText: Install Windows Steam or connect your Epic library. The games you've collected come with you.
storesNote: Games and store accounts are purchased separately.
dlssText: Bring DLSS upscaling to supported Windows games on your Mac through MetalFX
dlssNote: Requires a compatible game and engine with DXMT or D3DMetal. Enable DLSS in Highball and in the game's settings. Results depend on your Mac and the game.
demoNote: Illustrative preview, not a performance benchmark.
privacyText: No Highball account. No telemetry. No monthly bill. Your library lives on your Mac.
stepsTitle:
Three steps.
Then it's game time.
step1Text: Download Highball, drag it to Applications, and let it handle the first-time setup.
step2Text: Sign in to Steam or connect Epic. You already own the games; keep playing them.
step3Text: Check compatibility, apply any recommended fix, and launch your game.
setupNote: First setup can take around 20 minutes. Grab a drink; Highball gets things ready.
sourceTitle:
Made for players.
Built by people.
sourceText: Great gaming on Mac should belong to everyone. Highball is free, its code is public, and its community makes it better — one game at a time.
contributeText: Share how a game runs, suggest an improvement, or get involved on GitHub.
sourceNote: Built with Wine, DXMT, DXVK, and Apple's Game Porting Toolkit. Thanks to the people making Mac gaming possible.
a1: Yes. Highball is free and open source under GPL-3.0, with no paid tier. Games and any required store accounts are separate.
a2: Highball requires an Apple Silicon Mac and macOS 14 or later. Intel Macs are not supported. Compatibility and performance vary by game and Mac.
q3: Can I use the games I already own?
a3: Yes. Install Windows Steam or connect your Epic library. You use your existing store account and games; Highball does not sell games.
a4: Compatibility varies. Games requiring Windows kernel anti-cheat, including Valorant and Fortnite, cannot run through Highball. Check the database first: verified results, community reports, and predictions are clearly separated.
q5: How does DLSS work on a Mac?
a5: In compatible games and engines, Highball routes DLSS upscaling through MetalFX using DXMT or D3DMetal. Enable it in Highball and in the game. This does not mean every NVIDIA feature or every DLSS game is supported.

compatibilityText: Fortnite and Valorant can’t run through Highball because their Windows anti-cheat systems aren’t compatible with macOS.
compatibilityCaveat: Compatibility and performance vary by game and Mac. Check the latest reports before you download.
publisherBlockNote: The publisher has blocked the Windows version from running on macOS. Changing the graphics engine does not remove that restriction.
